full_prompt_en: The image is a square black-and-white long-exposure landscape photograph of a narrow stone causeway ending in a small group of bare-branched trees above still water. The causeway enters from the lower right corner as a broad dark wedge and narrows toward a point just left of center. Flat pale paving slabs run along its top, while a rough black stone side drops into the water. At the far end, several slim trunks rise close together, their irregular branches forming a soft clustered silhouette against the brightest part of the sky. One outer crown extends horizontally to the right, balancing the shorter sparse branches at the left. The surrounding water is smooth and nearly featureless, darker in the foreground and lightening toward a faint horizon. Beneath the trees, a blurry dark reflection hangs in the water, its edges softened by the long exposure. The sky carries broad gray cloud tones that grow darker at the top, but there is no sharp sunlight or distinct cloud edge. A bright horizontal band behind the trunks separates their dark fine branches from the muted water and sky. The viewpoint is low and oblique to the causeway, giving the paved strip a strong directional line and making the trees feel isolated at the end of the landform. Fine detail remains in the branches and paving joints, while the water and sky are smoothed into gradual tonal fields. The composition is sparse, with the wedge, clustered silhouette, and dim mirrored shape occupying only part of the open frame. The overall mood is still and contemplative, driven by deep charcoal, luminous gray, and wide quiet negative space.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一张方形黑白长曝光风景摄影：一条窄石堤尽头立着一小组疏枝树，周围是静水。石堤从右下角以宽暗楔形进入，向中央略左的一点收窄。顶部铺着平整浅色石板，粗糙黑石侧面落入水中。尽头几根细树干靠近升起，不规则枝条在天空最亮处前聚成柔和剪影。右侧外缘树冠水平伸出，平衡左边较短的疏枝。四周水面平顺而几乎没有细节，前景较暗，向隐约地平线渐亮。树下，一片模糊暗倒影悬在水中，边缘被长曝光柔化。天空带宽阔灰云调子，顶部更暗，却没有尖锐日光或明确云缘。树干后一条明亮横带把深色细枝从低饱和水天中分开。视点低且斜对石堤，让铺石带成为有力的导向线，也使树显得孤立在陆形尽头。枝条与石板接缝仍有细节，水与天空则被抹成渐变调子色场。构图稀疏，楔形、聚团剪影和暗淡镜像只占开阔画幅一部分。整体气氛静止而沉思，由深炭色、明亮灰色与宽阔安静留白推动。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white fine-art photography uses long-exposure smoothing to turn broad areas into seamless gradients from charcoal to luminous gray. A dark oblique wedge cuts into wide pale negative space and narrows toward a compact high-contrast cluster. Fine branching lines and a few straight joints remain sharp, while their lower mirror form is diffuse and indistinct. A bright horizontal band sits behind the most detailed silhouette, separating it cleanly from softer upper and lower fields. Gentle vignetting deepens the corners without closing the open composition. The value range is restrained and atmospheric, with texture reserved for the small focal zone and one rough edge. The overall rhythm is spare, directional, and deeply still.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白艺术摄影借长曝光平滑把宽阔区域化为从炭黑到亮灰的无缝渐变。一道暗色斜楔切入大片浅色留白，收向一处紧凑高反差聚团。细分枝线与少数直线接缝保持清楚，下方镜像形体则漫散而不确定。一条明亮横带垫在细节最多的剪影后，使它从较柔的上、下色场中清楚分开。温和暗角加深四角，又不关闭开放构图。明度范围克制而有空气感，纹理主要留给小焦点和一道粗糙边缘。整体节奏稀疏、有方向且极为静止。
theme_en: A narrow stone causeway ending in bare trees above still water
theme_zh: 一条窄石堤尽头的疏枝树立在静水上方
name: George Digalakis
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
